title: Parking Ticket Appeal
description: You received a parking ticket that seems unfair
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте, комиссия по апелляциям. У вас есть штраф на обжалование?
systemPrompt: You handle parking appeals. Ticket was for expired meter, but user says meter was broken. With evidence (photo of broken meter), can dismiss ticket. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User presented case and got decision on appeal.
hints: Паркомат не работал (The parking meter was not working)
У меня есть фотография (I have a photo)
Я прошу отменить штраф (I request to cancel the fine)
